task_instance: Created a sample MusicXML lead sheet (song.musicxml) in C major with a 3-measure melody and chord symbols (C, G7, F), then used music21 to transpose it to Eb major for a singer, writing song_transposed.musicxml and reporting the old/new key.
evidence: Installed music21 10.5.0 via pip. Generated song.musicxml programmatically (key signature 0 sharps/flats, notes C4-D4-E4-F4 / G4-A4-B4-C5 / E4-D4-C4, chord symbols C, G7, F). Wrote transpose.py which: loads song.musicxml with converter.parse, determines the current key (explicit Key element, else KeySignature defaulted to major, else key.analyze fallback), computes interval.Interval to the target key (Eb), calls score.transpose(iv) which transposes notes, chord symbols, and key signature together, then writes song_transposed.musicxml. Ran `python3 transpose.py` -> printed 'Old key: C major' / 'New key: E- major'. Verified output by reparsing both files: notes moved C4/D4/E4/F4/G4/A4/B4/C5/E4/D4/C4 -> E-4/F4/G4/A-4/B-4/C5/D5/E-5/G4/F4/E-4 (a minor third up, correct); chord symbols C/G7/F -> E-/B-7/A- (same interval, correct); key signature fifths 0 -> -3 (C major -> Eb major, correct). Files produced: song.musicxml, song_transposed.musicxml, transpose.py in the work directory.
